blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model's hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like "wait", which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model's CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model's logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess.

blocks.en:
Reasoning models such as Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1 write a chain of thought (CoT) between the tokens <think> and </think> before they answer.
On a hard problem the CoT holds most of the output, and a large part of it re-derives and re-verifies a result the model has already reached ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Sui et al., 2025 ) .
Under plain decoding, that is, sampling from the model as released, a correct run of Qwen3-32B writes 32–69% of its CoT after the correct answer first appears (Figure 1 ).
Not all of this checking is redundant. A check made while the model works, or a first check of its answer, can catch an error, but repeating a check that has already been made adds tokens without adding information.
A method that shortens the CoT should remove the redundant checks and keep the necessary ones.
blocks.zh:
Qwen3和DeepSeek-R1等理性模型在回答前在符号"think"和"/think"之间写一个连锁思维(CoT).
在一个难题上,CoT掌握了大部分产出,其中很大一部分重新确定并重新验证了模型已经达到的结果(Chen等人,2024年;Sui等人,2025年)。
在平面解码下,即从释放的模型中取样,在正确答案出现后(图1),Qwen3-32B正确运行了32-69%的CoT。
不是所有的检查都是多余的。 在模型工作期间所做的检查,或对其答案的第一次检查,可以捕捉到一个错误,但重复已经做成的检查会添加符号而不添加信息.
缩短COT的方法应当取消多余的检查,保留必要的检查.

blocks.en:
Existing methods for shortening the CoT fall into two groups.
Training-based methods add a length penalty or a token limit to reinforcement learning ( Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ; Hou et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) or fine-tune on short traces ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Both change the weights, so every new model needs another round of training.
Inference-time methods ask for brevity in the prompt ( Renze and Guven, 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , block words such as wait that open another round of checking ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , end the CoT once an answer looks ready or a token budget is spent ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Song et al., 2026 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) , or add a fixed steering vector to the model’s hidden states ( Azizi et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) .
Prompting depends on how closely the model follows the instruction.
Keyword bans suppress the same words across contexts, activation steering adds the same vector to the hidden states at every step, and early stopping ends the CoT once its criterion is met.
These controls can shorten useful reasoning as well as redundant checks.
blocks.zh:
现有缩短气候图的方法分为两组。
基于培训的方法为强化学习增加了一个长度处罚或象征性限制(Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025;Hou等人, 2025;Luo等人, 2025)或对短痕迹进行微调(Chen等人, 2024)。 两者都改变了权重,因此每个新模式都需要另一轮训练.
推论时间方法要求快速(Renze和Guven, ; 2024; Han等人, 2025; 徐等人, 2025) , 屏蔽字, 如等待打开另一轮检查(王等人, 2025) , 一旦有答案或象征性预算用完就结束 CoT(Yang等人, 2025b; Song等人, 2026; Muennighoff等人, 2025) , 或在模型的隐藏状态中添加固定方向向量(Azizi等人, 2026; Chen等人, 2025; Lin等人, 2025).

这些控制可以缩短有用的推理以及冗余检查.

blocks.en:
In this paper we propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method that steers a reasoning model with a much smaller reasoning model that shares its tokenizer (Figure 2 ).
At every step of the CoT, the small model reads the text the large model has written so far twice: once after an instruction to go straight to the answer, as the brief thinker , and once after an instruction to double-check every step, as the verbose thinker .
The difference between the two logit vectors, multiplied by a strength α \alpha , is added to the large model’s logits.
The small model only suggests a direction, towards what the brief thinker would write next and away from what the verbose thinker would.
The large model still decides which tokens are possible, and the CoT can end only where the large model itself would consider ending it (Section 2 ).
Inspired by DExperts ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , DoubtLess steers the large model through the vocabulary it shares with a small model, but needs no trained expert, since both sides of the contrast come from one off-the-shelf small model under two instructions.

blocks.en:
Two properties set DoubtLess apart from prompting, keyword bans, activation steering and early stopping.
First, the contrast is dynamic. It is recomputed from the current context at every step, so a word such as But is pushed down after an answer and left almost untouched before it, whereas a keyword ban blocks it everywhere and activation steering applies one fixed vector at every step.
Second, the brief and verbose thinkers disagree most after the correct answer first appears in the CoT, where the brief thinker would wrap up and the verbose one would check again (Section 5.1 ).
Most of the removed tokens come from this later checking.
blocks.zh:
除了提示、关键词禁止、激活方向和提早停止之外,还有两个属性设置了“怀疑Less”。
首先,对比是动态的。 它在每个步骤上都从当前上下文中重算出来,所以像 But 这样的单词在回答后被推倒,在它之前几乎没有被动过,而关键词禁令则在任何地方阻挡它,激活方向盘在每一个步骤上都应用一个固定的向量.
第二,简略和动词思想者在正确答案首先出现在CoT之后,分歧最多,简略思想者会在这里收尾,动词者会再次检查(第5.1节).
大部分被移除的代币都来自于后来的检查.

blocks.en:
We compare DoubtLess with five inference-time baselines on seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, with the model’s recommended sampling settings and three seeds per problem.
With Qwen3-32B steered by Qwen3-0.6B, DoubtLess removes 31% of the thinking tokens with unchanged accuracy, more than any baseline.
It keeps accuracy where the baselines lose it. On AIME 2025, for example, blocking the words that open another round of checking costs 14 points, while DoubtLess costs none.
DoubtLess also extends to an agent, a model trained for brevity and two other model families.
It reduces thinking per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent and further shortens the CoT of a model trained for brevity with LACONIC ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
On AIME 2025 and AMC 2023, it removes 25% and 40% of the thinking of EXAONE-4.0 and Granite-4.2, each steered by a small model of its own family, where a concise prompt removes 8% and 14%.
Finally, our ablations show that the strength sets how much is removed, that a negative strength lengthens the CoT instead, and that the shortening depends on which tokens the small model pushes down.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which an off-the-shelf small model, run under a brief and a verbose instruction, supplies a logit direction that shortens a reasoning model’s CoT. • An evaluation in which DoubtLess removes more thinking than five inference-time baselines on seven benchmarks with unchanged accuracy, and shortens the CoT of a self-debugging coding agent and of two other model families. • An analysis showing that the two thinkers disagree mainly after the answer first appears in the CoT, which is where most of the removed tokens lie.

blocks.en:
The two thinkers read the same text and differ only in the instruction, so they disagree only where the instruction matters (one CoT in Figure 3 ; the analysis in Section 5.1 ).
While the model is still working towards an answer, both expect the derivation to continue, and the CoT is left almost unchanged: in the upper box of Figure 3 only two tokens are shaded, and the Wait that opens a check inside the derivation is not one of them.
Once an answer has been stated, the verbose thinker expects another round of checking and the brief thinker expects the CoT to end, so the words that start a new check, such as But , Let and maybe in the lower box, are down-weighted by a factor of five or more.
Unlike NoWait, DoubtLess therefore bans no word. It makes another round of checking less likely to begin once an answer is in place, and what the CoT loses is those rounds.
Whether the next sentence starts another check or continues the derivation is largely a matter of form, which a small model can judge even on a problem it could not solve.
blocks.zh:
两位思想家阅读的文本相同,仅在指令中有所不同,因此他们只在指令重要时才有分歧(图3中一个CoT;图5.1中的分析).
虽然该模型仍在努力寻找答案,但两者都期望衍生物会继续下去,而CoT几乎保持不变:在图3的上框中,只有两个符号被遮蔽,在衍生物内部打开支票的Wait不是其中之一.
一旦给出了答案,动词思想家期待再进行一轮检查,而简短的思想家期待CoT结束,所以开始新检查的词,比如But,Let和也许在下方的框中,会被5个或5个以上的系数降低加权.
与Nowait不同,怀疑 因此,不禁止任何文字。 这使得另一轮检查在答案到位后不太可能开始,COT损失的是这些回合.
下一个句子是开始另一个检查还是继续产生,基本上是一个形式问题,一个小模型甚至可以判断它无法解决的问题.

blocks.en:
The contrast acts only on the CoT. The answer after </think> is decoded by the large model alone.
Within the CoT, the large model keeps its own logits for </think> and the end-of-sequence token and its own top- p p candidates, so the small model can only reorder tokens the large model was already willing to write (Algorithm 1 , Appendices A and C ).

对比只表现在CoT上. </think > 后的答案仅由大模型解码。
在CoT内部,大模型为 </think > 和序列末端符和自己的顶端-p候选人保留自己的日志,因此小模型只能重排大模型已经愿意写的符号(算法1,附录A和C).

blocks.en: 3 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en:
The large model M M is Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) in bfloat16 and the small model D D is Qwen3-0.6B. We write DoubtLess (0.6B) for this pair.
Section 4.2 repeats the comparison with plain decoding and the concise prompt on two other families: EXAONE-4.0-32B steered by EXAONE-4.0-1.2B ( LG AI Research, 2025 ) and Granite-4.2-30B steered by Granite-4.2-3B ( IBM Granite Team, 2026 ) .
Section 6 also uses Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B as the small model.
blocks.zh:
大型型号M M在bfloat16中为Qune3-32B(杨等人,2025a),小型型号D为Qune3-0.6B. 我们为这对写疑惑Less(0.6B).
第4.2节重复了与平面解码的比较,以及对另外两个家庭的简明提示: 出口4.0-32B 由EXAONE-4.0-1.2B(LG AI Research,2025年)和Granite-4.2-30B(IBM Granite Team,2026年)驾驶.
第6节还使用Quen3-1.7B和Quen3-4B作为小模型.

blocks.en:
We use seven benchmarks that are the standard testing ground of reasoning models: four mathematics competitions, AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 (30 problems each; Mathematical Association of America, 2025 ), HMMT February 2025 (30; HMMT, 2025 ) and AMC 2023 (40; Mathematical Association of America, 2023 ); graduate-level science questions from GPQA-Diamond (198; Rein et al., 2024 ); olympiad problems from OlympiadBench (100, drawn round-robin across subjects; He et al., 2024 ); and programming problems from LiveCodeBench (a fixed subset of 100 from release 6, drawn round-robin across the three difficulty levels; Jain et al., 2025 ).
Every benchmark is scored with its published answer key, and LiveCodeBench by running the program against the test cases (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
我们使用了作为推理模型标准测试基础的七个基准:四个数学竞赛,AIME 2024年和AIME 2025年(每场30个问题;美国数学协会,2025年),HMMT 2025年2月(30;HMMT,2025年)和AMC 2023年(40;美国数学协会,2023年);GPQA-Diamond的研究生一级科学问题(198;Rein等人,2024年);Olympiad Bench的奥林匹亚问题(100,跨学科抽取圆-robin;He等人,2024年);LiveCode Bench的编程问题(从6版抽取的100个固定子集,跨越三个难度级别;Jain等人,2025年)。
每个基准都用其公布的答案密钥打分,LiveCode Bench则通过对照测试案例运行程序(Appendix E.

blocks.en:
We compare DoubtLess with plain decoding and with five training-free methods of the kinds in Section 1 : a prompt, a ban on words, two rules that end the CoT early and a steering vector. Concise prompt asks the large model itself to be brief: the brief thinker’s sentence, which tells the model to go straight to the answer and not to re-derive or re-verify anything, is appended to the large model’s own instruction. How much it removes depends on how closely the large model follows the instruction. NoWait ( Wang et al., 2025 ) blocks 17 words that open another round of checking ( wait , alternatively , hmm , but , however and others) throughout the generation, by adding a bias of − 100 -100 to the logits of their single-token forms (89 token ids). DEER ( Yang et al., 2025b ) ends the CoT early. At each of the first ten occurrences of Wait it induces a trial answer, ends the CoT if the geometric mean of the trial’s token probabilities exceeds 0.95 0.95 , and otherwise discards the trial and lets the CoT continue. It also ends the CoT once it reaches 0.8 of the budget.
A DEER run is a prefix of the plain-decoding run followed by </think> and a freshly sampled answer, so we evaluate it on the stored plain-decoding runs with the same engine, sampler and seeds (Appendix D ). ThinkBrake ( Song et al., 2026 ) ends the CoT at a sentence boundary once </think> comes within a logit margin of 0.1 0.1 of the most likely token, read after a single newline as in the authors’ code, and is evaluated like DEER (Appendix D ). ASC ( Azizi et al., 2026 ) adds a fixed steering vector to the large model’s hidden states after one layer, at every decoding step. We use the training-free version in the authors’ released code, in which the vector is the mean difference between the hidden states at the last token of a verbose and of a concise CoT, here Qwen3-32B’s own CoTs on 100 MATH-500 problems ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) under its plain instruction and under the brief thinker’s sentence. It is added after layer 57 of 64, the layer the authors use for the 64-layer QwQ-32B, with the strength chosen on AIME 2026 ( Mathematical Association of America, 2026 ) as for DoubtLess (Appendix D ).
We also decode the random-target control of Section 6.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们比较怀疑Less与简单的解码, 以及第1节中的5种无训练方法: 迅速, 禁止文字, 简明的即时要求大模型本身简洁:短思家的句子,告诉模型直接到答案,而不要重新贬低或重新验证任何东西,都附在大模型自己的指示中. 其去除多少取决于大模型遵循指令的距离. Nowait (Wang et al., 2025)封锁了17个字, DEER(Yang等人,2025年b)提前结束CoT. 在“等待”的前十次事件中,每一次都引起一个审判答案,如果审判的几何平均值超过0.95 0.95,则结束“等待”,否则就放弃审判,让“等待”继续。 一旦达到预算的0.8,它也将结束竞争。
DEER运行是plain-decoding运行的前缀,之后是 </think > ,也是新样本的答案,因此我们在存储的plain-decoding运行上用相同的引擎,采样器和种子(Appendix D.)进行评价. ThinkBrake(Song et al., 2026年)在句子边界上结束 CoT, 一旦 </think > 在最有可能的符号的0.1 0.1的对数边距内,按作者代码的一条新线读取,并像DEER(附录D)一样进行评价。 ASC(Azizi等人,2026年)在大模型的隐藏状态中,在每一解码步骤的一层后,都添加了固定方向向量. 我们使用作者发布的代码中的无训练版本,其中矢量是隐藏状态在动词的最后符号和简明CoT的中间区别,这里是Qune3-32B自己的关于100 MATH-500问题的 CoTs(Hendrycks et al., 2021;Lightman et al., 2024),根据它的简单指示和简短的思想家的句子. 它在64的57层之后添加,作者用于64层的QwQ-32B的层,其强度选择在AIME 2026上(美国数学协会,2026年),对于DonestLess(附录D.
我们还解码了第6.1节的随机目标控制

blocks.en:
All methods sample with Qwen3’s recommended thinking settings, temperature 0.6 0.6 , top- p p 0.95 0.95 and top- k k 20 20 , under a thinking budget of 32,768 tokens (24,576 on GPQA-Diamond). A run that reaches the budget without ending its CoT counts as wrong.
Every problem is decoded with three seeds. We call one decoding of one problem under one seed a run , and accuracy is the mean over runs.
DoubtLess uses α = 5 \alpha{=}5 (the best trade-off on AIME 2026; Appendix F ), one value for every model pair and every benchmark. Section 6.2 varies it.
All methods run in the same vLLM engine, with DoubtLess and the control computed inside it (Appendix D ).

使用Qune3推荐的思维设置的所有方法样本,温度0.6 0.6,顶端-p 0.95 0.95和顶端-kk 20 20, 其思维预算为32,768令牌(GPQA-Diamond上的24,576). 跑到预算 而不结束CoT就算错了

所有方法都运行在同一个vLLM引擎中,其中怀疑Less及其内部的控制计算(附录D ).

blocks.en:
We report accuracy and the change in the number of thinking tokens, the tokens of the CoT, against plain decoding.
The change is taken over all problems, solved or not, with a 95% bootstrap interval over problems. Appendix G gives the formula and the change over the problems both methods solve, the measure of earlier work.
Since a run that reaches the budget counts as wrong, we also report the share of such runs.
blocks.zh:
我们报告准确性 和改变 思考符号数量, CoT 的标志, 与平庸的解码。
改变会解决所有的问题,不管是否解决, 95%的靴子间隔会解决。 附 录 G给出了公式和对两种方法都解决的问题的改变,即对早先工作的衡量.
由于达到预算水平的运行算错了,我们还报告了此类运行的份额。

blocks.en: 4.1 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en:
Across the seven benchmarks, DoubtLess removes 31% of the thinking tokens with unchanged accuracy (Table 1 , overall column; intervals in Table 7 ).
This is the largest reduction among the six methods (Figure 4 a).
The concise prompt comes closest, but DoubtLess removes more than it on six of the seven benchmarks.
The other baselines remove less, and ThinkBrake and NoWait lose more accuracy than DoubtLess.
blocks.zh:
在7个基准中,怀疑莱斯删除了31%的思维信号,准确性不变(表1,总栏;表7的间隔)。
这是六种方法中最大的减少(图4a)。
简洁的提示最接近,但怀疑莱斯删除了超过7个基准中的6个.
其他的基线去掉的更少,而ThinkBrake和Nowait失去的精度比WonderLess更准确.

blocks.en:
DoubtLess shortens the CoT significantly on every benchmark (Table 7 ).
The baselines are uneven.
On mathematics, the concise prompt removes less on harder benchmarks, from 31% on AMC 2023 to 13% on HMMT 2025, the easiest and the hardest for plain decoding, while DoubtLess still removes 31% on HMMT 2025.
ThinkBrake cuts the CoT on science and code but barely on mathematics.
blocks.zh:
在每一基准上,怀疑Less都大大缩短了气候图(表7)。
基线不均匀。
在数学方面,简洁的速率在较硬的基准上去掉较少,从AMC 2023的31%到HMMT 2025的13%,这是最简单和最难进行普通解码的,而WonderLess仍然在HMMT 2025上去掉31%。
ThinkBrake在科学和代码上削减了CoT,但在数学上却几乎没有削减.

blocks.en:
In contrast, NoWait, DEER and ThinkBrake each lose accuracy significantly on at least one benchmark (Table 7 ): NoWait on AIME 2025 and LiveCodeBench, DEER on LiveCodeBench, and ThinkBrake on OlympiadBench and LiveCodeBench.
DoubtLess also lowers the share of runs that reach the budget, from 2.4% under plain decoding to 0.4%.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,Nowait,DEER和ThinkBrake各在至少一个基准(表7)上都明显失去准确性:Nowait on AIME 2025和LiveCode Bench,DEER在LiveCode Bench上,ThinkBrake在Olympiad Bench和LiveCode Bench上.
怀疑Less还降低了达到预算的运行份额,从普通解码的2.4%降至0.4%。

blocks.en: 4.2 Other model families
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 其他模范家庭

blocks.en:
DoubtLess carries over to EXAONE-4.0 and Granite-4.2, each steered by a small model of its own family, and shortens their CoT without losing accuracy (Figure 4 b, Table 8 in Appendix H ).
The concise prompt, however, varies from model to model. It comes close to DoubtLess on Qwen3-32B, but on the other two DoubtLess removes about three times as much.
This depends on whether the model complies.
A prompt can only ask the large model to be brief, and models differ in how far they follow such a request, whereas DoubtLess asks the large model for nothing and changes its next-token distribution directly.
blocks.zh:
" 怀疑Less " 转到EXAONE-4.0和Granite-4.2, 各自由自己家庭的一个小模型指导,并在不丧失准确性的情况下缩短COT(图4b,附录H表8)。
然而,简洁的提示因型号而异。 与Qun3-32B上的"怀疑莱斯"接近,但另外两部"怀疑莱斯"的删除量大约是"怀疑莱斯"的三倍.
这取决于模型是否遵守.
一个提示只能要求大模型简洁,模型在遵循这样的请求的多远上各有不同,而DrightLess则问大模型什么也不做,直接改变它的下个子分布.

blocks.en: 4.3 Coding agent
blocks.zh: 4.3 编码代理人

blocks.en:
We extend DoubtLess to a self-debugging coding agent on HumanEval+ ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , which writes a program, runs the tests and gets one repair turn on failure. DoubtLess is applied inside the CoT of every turn (Appendix J ).
Over the 164 problems, the agent thinks 20% less per turn and improves its pass rate by 2.0 points over plain decoding (Table 1 , Agent column).
DEER removes 41% and improves the pass rate by 4.5 points. It ends the CoT once 80% of the turn’s thinking budget is spent, which leaves room for a program in every turn, whereas under plain decoding 16–20% of the turns use the whole budget for thinking and write no program (Appendix J ).
NoWait and ThinkBrake remove more but lower the pass rate, ThinkBrake by 6.9 points.
blocks.zh:
在HumanEval+上将怀疑Less扩展为自调试编码代理 (Chen et al., 2021;Liu et al., 2023),写作程序,运行测试,并获得一次故障的修复开启. 怀疑Less在每转弯的 CoT 内应用(附录 J ).
超过164个问题,代理商认为每转弯减少20%,并比普通解码器提高2.0分的通过率(表1,代理柱).
DEER删除41%,提高通过率4.5分. 一旦80%的转折思维预算用完,COT就结束了,这为每个转折程序留出了空间,而在16–20%的转折中,整个预算用于思考和写无程序(附录J ) 。
Nowait and ThinkBrake去除更多但降低通过率,ThinkBrake的成绩为6.9分.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis and discussion
blocks.zh: 5 分析和讨论

blocks.en: 5.1 What DoubtLess removes
blocks.zh: 5.1 怀疑什么 减去删除

blocks.en: Figure 6: After the answer, DoubtLess checks briefly and stops, while plain decoding gets stuck repeating the same check. AIME 2025 problem 1, first seed: the CoT under each method from the first statement of the answer (bold) to its end. Checks are in red, and [. . .] marks omitted text; full CoTs in Appendix L .

blocks.en:
We split each run at the point where the correct answer first appears in the CoT (Appendix I ).
DoubtLess cuts the thinking after this point by half and the thinking before it by a fifth (Figure 5 a), so most of the removed tokens lie after it on each of the six benchmarks on which the answer can be located (Table 11 ).
In Figure 6 , both methods reach the answer after about a thousand tokens, and plain decoding then returns to the same check again and again.
Useful checks remain. On AIME 2025 problem 11, an algebraic check restores a wrongly excluded root, which is then included in the final answer (Appendix I ).
blocks.zh:
我们每次运行在正确答案首先出现在 CoT (Appendix I ) 的点上分开.
怀疑Less在此点之后将思维削减了一半,将思维削减了五分之一(图5 a),因此大多数被移除的符号在它之后都停留在答案可以依据的六个基准上(表11).
在图6中,两种方法在约千个令牌后都到达答案,而平面解码后会一次又一次回到同一个检查.
仍有有益的检查。 在AIME 2025问题11上,一个代数检查恢复一个被错误排除的根,然后将它列入最终答案(附录一.

(a) Divergence of the two next-token distributions, aligned at the first automatic match to the correct answer. (b) Brief minus verbose log-probability of selected words, before and after the answer.
blocks.zh: 图 7:两位思想家在回答后意见不一. 正确的plain-decoding运行在AIME 2025上,由两个指令下的小模型读取. (a) 两种接吻分布的差别,在第一次自动匹配时与正确答案对齐。 (b) 回答前后选定词的简便减动词对数概率。

Read by the small model under both instructions, correct plain-decoding runs on AIME 2025 show a mean divergence between the two next-token distributions seven times larger after the answer than before it (Figure 7 a), and the same holds under human-annotated answer boundaries (Appendix I ).
After the answer the direction pushes down the words that open another round, such as But , However and Alternatively , which it leaves almost untouched before the answer (Figure 7 b).
blocks.zh:
在两个指令下由小模型读取,在AIME 2025上正确的plain-decoding运行显示,在回答后,两个邻接的分布比之前大7倍(图7 a),在人为附加说明的回答边界(附录一)下也存在同样的偏差.
在回答后,方向推倒了打开另一回合的字句,例如But, But and Over ,在回答前几乎未触及(图7b).

blocks.en:
Wait , But and Alternatively occur at least as often per thousand thinking tokens under DoubtLess as under plain decoding, whereas NoWait suppresses them (Figure 5 b).
DoubtLess removes rounds of checking, and the checks that remain still begin with these words (Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh:
等待,但或者至少每千个在怀疑Less下思考的代币和在普通解码下发生同样频繁,而Nowait则压制它们(图5b)。
怀疑Less删除了检查的轮数,剩下的检查仍然从这些单词开始(图6).

blocks.en: 5.2 DoubtLess complements training-based compression
blocks.zh: 5.2 怀疑 减少对基于培训的压缩的补充

blocks.en:
Training-based methods shorten the CoT by changing the weights, while DoubtLess acts only at decoding time, so the two can be combined.
We test this on a Qwen3-32B checkpoint fine-tuned with LACONIC ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , which adds an adaptive length penalty to the task reward during reinforcement learning, and steer it with Qwen3-0.6B at α = 5 \alpha{=}5 .
Across mathematics, science and coding-agent benchmarks, DoubtLess further reduces thinking tokens by 29–52% with unchanged task performance (Table 2 ).
DoubtLess thus complements training-based compression and applies to an already compressed model without further training.
blocks.zh:
基于训练的方法通过改变权重来缩短CoT,而WonderLess只在解码时间作用,所以两者可以合并.
校对:Soup
在数学、科学和编码代理基准方面,怀疑莱斯将思维符号进一步减少29-52%,任务性能不变(表2)。
因此,怀疑Less是对基于培训的压缩的补充,并适用于已经压缩的模型,而无需进一步培训。

blocks.en: 5.3 Inference cost
blocks.zh: 5.3 推论费用

blocks.en:
We measure end-to-end inference latency on a single B200 GPU, decoding one problem at a time on 14 problems, two from each of the seven benchmarks.
DoubtLess takes 119.4 seconds per problem on average, compared with 156.2 seconds for plain decoding and 137.5 seconds for the concise prompt, reducing latency by 24% and 13%, respectively.
The small model’s two forward passes of 0.6B parameters per step add about 4% to the FLOPs of the 32B model.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个单一的B200GPU来测量端到端的推论延迟,一次解码一个问题,共14个问题,从7个基准中各2个.
怀疑Less平均每个问题需要119.4秒,而平面解码为156.2秒,简洁的即时器为137.5秒,分别将延迟率降低24%和13%.
小模型的两条前传每步0.6B参数为32B模型的FLOP增加了约4%.

blocks.en: 6 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 6 读取研究

blocks.en: We vary the direction and the strength of the contrast and the size of the small model.
blocks.zh: 我们改变对比的方向和强度以及小模型的大小.

blocks.en: 6.1 Effect of the contrast direction
blocks.zh: 6.1 对比方向的影响

blocks.en:
The random-target control tests whether the shortening comes from which tokens the small model pushes down or from perturbing the logits at all.
At every step it keeps the adjustment values α ⁡ ( z brief − z verbose ) \alpha(z_{\mathrm{brief}}-z_{\mathrm{verbose}}) but assigns them to randomly chosen tokens of the top- p p set, so the size and scope of the change stay the same and only its direction is lost.
With random targets, the thinking length stays within 8% of plain decoding on every benchmark and changes by 1% overall, against 31% for DoubtLess (Table 7 , Figure 10 ).
The shortening therefore comes from the direction the small model supplies.
blocks.zh:
随机-目标控制测试 缩短是来自哪个符号 小模型推倒还是从扰动对数。
在每一个步骤上,它都保持调整值α (z简写-z动词)\alpha(z_{\mathrm{brief}}-z_{\mathrm{verbose}}),但将它们分配给随机选择的顶级-p集的令牌,因此变化的大小和范围保持不变,只有其方向丢失.
在随机目标的情况下,每个基准的思维长度保持在简单解码的8%以内,总体变化为1%,而怀疑Less为31%(表7,图10)。
因此,缩短来自小型模型供应的方向。

blocks.en: 6.2 Effect of the strength
blocks.zh: 6.2 强度的影响

blocks.en:
On AIME 2025, DoubtLess removes more as the strength grows, with unchanged accuracy up to the default α = 5 \alpha{=}5 , and at α = 10 \alpha{=}10 it loses 7.8 points (Figure 8 ).
A negative strength, α = − 5 \alpha{=}{-}5 , lengthens the CoT by 26% instead, so the strength also sets the direction of the change.
blocks.zh:
在AIME 2025上,疑惑莱斯会随着强度的增大而去除更多,其精确度不变,高达默认的α = 5\alpha{=}5,而在α = 10\alpha{=}10时则会失去7.8分(图8).
一个负强度,α = − 5\ α = 5,使CoT延长26%,因此强度也确定了变化的方向.

blocks.en: 6.3 Effect of the small-model size
blocks.zh: 6.3 小模型尺寸的影响

blocks.en:
We show that a larger small model at the same α \alpha acts as a stronger contrast. With Qwen3-1.7B or Qwen3-4B in place of Qwen3-0.6B, DoubtLess removes close to 60% of the thinking tokens on AIME 2025 and, like α = 10 \alpha{=}10 with the 0.6B model, goes past the point where accuracy holds (Table 5 ).
With Qwen3-32B itself as the small model (at α = 1 \alpha{=}1 ), DoubtLess removes 26%, against 29% for the 0.6B model, so the smallest and cheapest model of the family, our default, gives up nothing.
blocks.zh:
我们显示,一个更大的小模型 在同一α-α, 起到更强的对比作用。 由于Qune3–1.7B或Qune3–4B取代了Qune3–0.6B,疑惑Less在AIME 2025上移除了近60%的思维符,和α = 10\alpha{=}10一样,使用0.6B模型,超过了准确度的临界点(表5).
与 Quen3-32B 键 作为小模型(在α = 1\alpha{=}1),怀疑莱斯删除了26%,而0.6B模型删除了29%,所以家庭最小和最便宜的模型,我们的默认,一概不放弃.

blocks.en: 7 Related work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en:
Reasoning models spend a large share of their tokens re-deriving and re-verifying results they have already reached, even on simple problems ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Sui et al., 2025 ) , and their token spend tracks the difficulty of a problem only loosely ( Pu et al., 2025 ) .
Section 5.1 shows that the tokens DoubtLess removes come mainly from the checking after the answer.
blocks.zh:
理性模型花费了大量的代币,重新铸造并重新验证它们已经达到的结果,即使是在简单的问题上(Chen等人,2024年;Sui等人,2025年),其代币支出只是松散地跟踪一个问题的难度(Pu等人,2025年).
第5.1节显示, " 怀疑莱斯 " 移除的标志主要来自答复后的检查。

blocks.en:
Methods that leave the model unchanged end the CoT once a budget is spent or the answer appears settled ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Song et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Pu et al., 2025 ) , skip it ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , block the words that open another round of checking ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , or ask for brevity in the prompt ( Renze and Guven, 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , which works only as far as the model follows the request ( Han et al., 2025 ; Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ) .
Activation steering adds a fixed vector to the hidden states, taken from concise and verbose CoTs ( Azizi et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) or from execution and reflection steps ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , with a strength that can follow a signal read from the model ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Budget Guidance ( Li et al., 2026a ) reweights the next-token distribution with a trained length predictor.
DoubtLess also reweights the next-token distribution, but its direction comes from an off-the-shelf small model, is recomputed from the context at every step and leaves the large model’s own logit for </think> untouched.
blocks.zh:
一旦预算用完或答复似乎已经解决(Muennighoff等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年b;Song等人,2026年;Fu等人,2024年;Pu等人,2025年),没有改变模式的方法将终止汇率,跳过(Ma等人,2025年),阻断打开另一轮检查的字眼(Wang等人,2025年),或要求及时做到简洁(Renze和Guven,2024年;Han等人,2025年;Xu等人,2025年),这只按照请求(Han等人,2025年;Aggarwal和Welleck,2025年)。
激活方向为隐藏状态添加了固定的矢量,取自简洁动词CoTs(Azizi等人,2026年;Huang等人,2025年)或执行和反射步骤(Chen等人,2025年),其强度可跟随从模型读取的信号(Lin等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年b). 预算指南(Li等人,2026年a)用训练有素的长度预测器重置了旁边的吻合分布.
怀疑Less还重估了下个脚本的分布,但其方向来自现成的小模型,每一步都从上下文中重算出来,并留下了大模型本身的登录号来进行 </think > 。

blocks.zh: 图8:较大优势去除更多思维符号,准确度维持在默认的α = 5\alpha{=}5. AIME 2025,每问题3个种子,间隔95%(表4).

blocks.en:
Training-based methods add a length term or a token limit to reinforcement learning ( Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ; Hou et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) or fine-tune on short traces ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
Each model needs its own training run, and the trade-off between length and accuracy is fixed once training ends.
DoubtLess leaves the model unchanged, sets the trade-off with one strength at decoding time and can be added to a model trained this way (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
以培训为基础的方法为强化学习增加了一个学期或象征性限制(Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025;Hou等人, 2025;Luo等人, 2025;Liu等人, 2026)或对短痕迹进行微调(Chen等人, 2024)。
每个型号都需要自己的训练跑步,训练结束后,长度和准确度之间的权衡就会固定下来.
怀疑莱斯让模型保持不变,在解码时间用一个强度来决定权衡,并且可以添加到这样训练的模型中(第5.2节)。

blocks.en:
Contrastive decoding scores the next token by the difference between an expert and a weaker amateur model ( Li et al., 2023 ; O’Brien and Lewis, 2023 ) , and DExperts and proxy-tuning steer a large model with small models that share only its vocabulary ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) .
ThinkLogit ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and ProxyThinker ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) add the difference between a small reasoning model and its base to make a large model reason more, Thinking by Subtraction ( Tang et al., 2026 ) contrasts a model with a masked copy of its own context, and PromptCD ( Bi et al., 2026 ) and Dong et al. (2026) contrast two prompts on the steered model itself.
DoubtLess draws the contrast from an off-the-shelf small model under two instructions and uses it to shorten the CoT.
Small models also work beside large ones as drafters in speculative decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ) , as token suggesters in Nudging ( Fei et al., 2025 ) and as sentence completers in FoReaL decoding ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
对比解码通过专家与弱业余模式的区别(Li等人,2023年;O'Brien和Lewis,2023年),以及DExperts和代理调制对一个只分享其词汇的小型模式的大型模式(Liu等人,2021年;Liu等人,2024年)来评分下一个符号.
ThinkLogit (Zhang et al., 2026)和ProxyThinker (Xiao et al., 2025) 添加了小推理模型与其基础的区别,以让大模型的理由更进一步, ThinkLogit by Subtraction (Tang et al., 2026) 对比了一个带有自己上下文的蒙面拷贝的模型,以及TeanCD(Bi et al., 2026)和Dong et al. (2026年)对比了两个导引模型本身.
怀疑莱斯从两个指令下的现成小模型中抽取对比,并用它来缩短CoT.
小型模型在大型模型之外,还充当投机性解码的起草者(Leviathan等人,2023年),在Nudging公司(Fei等人,2025年)担任象征性建议者,在ForeaL解码公司(Li等人,2025年)担任句子完成者。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
DoubtLess adds the difference between a small reasoning model’s brief and verbose thinkers to a large reasoning model’s logits while it writes its CoT.
On seven benchmarks it removes 31% of the thinking tokens of Qwen3-32B with unchanged accuracy, more than five inference-time baselines.
It also shortens the CoT of a coding agent, and on two other model families it removes about three times as much as a concise prompt.
Combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity.
Our analyses support the explanation that DoubtLess reduces redundant checking while retaining useful verification.
blocks.zh:
一个小推理模型的简短思想家和动词思想家,
在7个基准上,它以不变的精确度去除31%的Qwen3-32B思维符,超过5个推断时间基线.
它还缩短了编码代理的CoT,在另外两个模型家族上,它去除大约是简洁的提示的三倍.
它与基于培训的压缩相结合,进一步缩短了已经为简洁化而培训过的模型的通用技术。
我们的分析支持这样的解释,即怀疑莱斯减少重复核查,同时保留有用的核查。

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 One decoding step inside the CoT
blocks.zh: 算法 1个编码步骤

blocks.en:
The contrast is added only while the large model writes its CoT, and the answer after </think> is decoded by the large model alone.
Inside the CoT, the algorithm restores the large model’s own logits for </think> and the end-of-sequence token, so the CoT ends only where the large model itself would consider ending it.
At such a point the contrast changes the competition. By lowering the tokens that open another round of checking, it lets the large model’s own </think> win more often.
The mask is applied last, so the candidates are the top- p p set of the large model’s distribution at temperature one and the contrast never brings in a token outside it.
The method has one hyperparameter, the strength α \alpha .

blocks.en:
The large model runs in vLLM 0.29 ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) with tensor parallelism. We load the small model into the same vLLM model as the large one, so that a single request drives all three streams of Figure 2 .
The small model keeps one copy of its linear weights but two copies of its attention layers, one for the brief thinker and one for the verbose thinker. The two thinkers go through the linear layers together, as a doubled batch, and through attention separately. Under tensor parallelism the small model is split across the GPUs by attention head, like the large model.
The three streams differ only in the instruction sentence, which sits between the problem and the last few tokens of the chat template (Appendix B ). Everything else, the prompt, those template tokens and the generated tokens, uses the same slot mapping in the three streams’ paged KV caches, and we keep it in one paged key–value cache. The request’s block table is allocated for the large model’s sequence, and the small model’s attention layers, which have the same cache layout (eight key–value heads of dimension 128 in bfloat16, split across the GPUs), write their keys and values into the same blocks. vLLM then allocates, accounts for and frees the three streams as one, with no padding and no duplicated copies.
The keys and values of the instruction sentence itself, at most 64 tokens per thinker, live in a small buffer per request that is allocated together with the model. The position IDs are those of each stream’s own sequence, so the thinkers see the template tokens and the generated tokens shifted by the length of their sentence. A key stores its own position, so the order of the blocks does not have to match the order of the positions.
A thinker’s attention is computed in two parts, paged attention over the request’s blocks and dense attention over the instruction buffer, which are merged by their log-sum-exp (vLLM’s cascade-attention kernel does exactly this). The result is the attention over the full sequence.
In the first step all three streams prefill the problem. The small model then reads its two instruction sentences against the cached problem and fills the buffer, after which decoding proceeds with every sampled token fed to all three streams.
The forward pass returns the three hidden states. At the logits step we apply the three output heads, form z base + α ⁡ ( z brief − z verbose ) z_{\mathrm{base}}+\alpha(z_{\mathrm{brief}}-z_{\mathrm{verbose}}) for the requests that are still inside their CoT, restore the </think> and end-of-sequence logits, mask to the large model’s top- p p set (the random-target control permutes the difference within that set here) and pass z z to vLLM’s sampler, which draws with the request’s temperature, top- p p , top- k k and seed.
Whether a request has left its CoT is tracked on the GPU from the tokens fed to the model, so asynchronous scheduling and CUDA graphs work as usual. After </think> the contrast is no longer applied.
The small model runs on a second CUDA stream and overlaps the large model’s forward pass, and one CUDA graph per decoding step covers both models.
With one problem in flight, a decoding step is bound by reading the large model’s weights (65.5 GB in bfloat16), and the small model’s kernels run on the second stream while those weights stream, with vLLM’s fused kernels for its normalization and rotary embedding and a single call of its output head for both thinkers.
We time each tokenized request from submission to the engine until the complete response text is returned, including prefill and decoding.
Before a run we check that the two vocabularies have the same size (151,936 for Qwen3) and that the instruction, <think> and </think> encode to the same ids with both tokenizers.

The blocked words are the seventeen of Wang et al. (2025) , listed in Appendix B .
The paper expands each word to every vocabulary token that contains it as a substring and then removes unreasonable matches by hand (its example is Ohio for oh ). On the Qwen3 vocabulary the substring rule matches 918 tokens, most of them unrelated words such as know , many , company and button , and the filtered list is not published.
We block the 89 single-token forms of the words: the word itself, with a leading space, capitalized, in upper case and after a period, which are the forms the paper gives as its example for wait .
The bias is − 100 -100 , the most negative value vLLM accepts, applied to the whole generation, with a 32,768-token budget as in the paper (24,576 on GPQA-Diamond) and the sampling settings of Appendix E .
For Qwen3-32B over five seeds, the paper reports chains 13–16% shorter on AMC 2023, AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 with accuracy changes of − 0.8 -0.8 , + 2.0 +2.0 and − 2.7 -2.7 points, and on GPQA-Diamond chains 15% shorter at − 6.1 -6.1 points.

ThinkBrake ( Song et al., 2026 ) ends the CoT at a sentence boundary when the margin between the most likely next token other than </think> and </think> , on the temperature-scaled logits, is at most τ \tau . Its paper uses τ = 0.1 \tau{=}0.1 for every Qwen3 model.
The paper does not say in which state the margin is read. Its only released code (for its tool-use benchmark) appends a period and a single newline to each prefix and reads </think> there, which is the state in which Qwen3 closes its CoT on its own. In our runs every natural close follows a single-newline token, whereas a sentence inside the CoT mostly ends in a blank-line token, after which </think> is never near the top. Read in the state the model actually wrote, the rule therefore does not fire.
We therefore follow the released code. At every sentence boundary, a token that ends a sentence and is followed by whitespace, or a token that ends with a newline, the sentence’s last token is replaced by its single-newline form ( .\n\n becomes .\n ) and the margin is read there. Where the rule fires, the run keeps its CoT up to that sentence, followed by the single newline, </think> and a freshly sampled answer. Like DEER, ThinkBrake is evaluated on the stored plain-decoding runs.
It removes 21% of the thinking tokens over the seven benchmarks at a cost of 2.3 points: 37% on GPQA-Diamond and 44% on LiveCodeBench, where it costs 2.0 and 4.7 points, and 3–4% on the five others (Table 7 ). The paper reports 4–6% fewer thinking tokens on AIME 2024 and 2025 and 20% on GPQA-Diamond for Qwen3-32B with a 16k budget.

blocks.en: The published version of ASC learns the steering vector by gradient descent, which requires an additional training run. We follow the training-free version in the authors’ released code, which adds the mean of the last-token differences between verbose and concise CoTs, scaled by a strength, to the output of one decoder layer at every forward pass, so at every generated token and at the last prompt token. The calibration set is the first 100 problems of MATH-500 in an order that cycles through its subjects. For each, Qwen3-32B writes one CoT under its plain instruction and one under the brief thinker’s sentence, with the sampling settings of Appendix E and a 16,384-token budget, and both are read back after the plain instruction. The authors write the concise CoTs with GPT-4o, and we use the large model’s own. The vector is added after layer 57. Its strength ρ \rho is the norm of the added vector relative to the mean norm of the hidden state at that layer, and ρ = 0.2 \rho{=}0.2 is chosen on AIME 2026 (Table 6 ).

blocks.en: Appendix J The self-debugging agent

blocks.en:
The agent solves each of the 164 HumanEval+ problems ( Liu et al., 2023 ) in at most two turns.
In the first turn the model receives the function to complete with the instruction “Complete this Python function. Return the FULL function in one python block”, thinks, and writes the program. The program is run against the HumanEval+ tests.
If it fails, the model receives the test’s error message with the instruction “Your program failed the tests with this error: … Fix the program. Return the FULL function in one python block” and gets one more turn.
Every turn has its own CoT with a budget of 4,096 tokens and 1,024 tokens for the program. DoubtLess is applied inside each CoT exactly as in the single-turn runs, with the same two thinker sentences appended to the last user message, NoWait blocks the same 89 token ids, the concise prompt appends the brief sentence to the last user message, and the random-target control is applied as in the single-turn runs.
DEER and ThinkBrake run inside each turn as it is decoded, since an early exit in the first turn changes the program that the repair turn sees. DEER uses the code inducer and 1,024-token trials of LiveCodeBench (Appendix D ) and cuts the CoT at 0.8 × 0.8\times the turn’s thinking budget. ThinkBrake first decodes the turn as plain decoding with the same seed, reads its rule at the sentence boundaries of that CoT as in the single-turn runs, and closes the CoT at the first boundary where it fires, followed by a freshly sampled program.
Under plain decoding 16–20% of the turns reach the budget of 4,096 thinking tokens without closing their CoT and so write no program. DoubtLess halves the number of such turns, and DEER’s cut leaves none.
The random-target control leaves the thinking per turn within 1% of plain decoding and the pass rate within 1.2 points.
Three seeds per problem. The pass rate counts a problem as solved if the program passes all tests after the first or the second turn, averaged over seeds, and thinking tokens are averaged over turns and seeds.

如果失败, 模型会收到测试的错误消息, 并附带指令 " 您的程序以这个错误失败了测试 :... 修复程序。 在一个蟒蛇块中返回 FLL 函数” , 并得到一个转弯 。
每轮都有自己的CoT,预算为4,096令牌和1,024令牌,用于该方案. 疑惑Less在每一个 CoT内部的应用与单回合运行完全相同,上一个用户消息后面附加了相同的两个思想家句子,Nowait屏蔽了相同的89个符号ID,简洁的即时附加句子在上一个用户消息后面,随机目标控制也和单回合运行一样.
DEER和ThinkBrake在每一个转弯内运行,因为它被解码,因为第一个转弯的早期退出会改变修复转弯所看到的程序. DEER使用代码诱导器和1,024-token对LiveCode Bench(附录D)的试验,并将CoT削减为0.8×0.8乘以转弯的思维预算. ThinkBrake首先将转弯解码为使用相同种子的平面解码,在 CoT 的句子边界读取其规则和单转跑的句子边界一样,在它发火的第一个边界关闭 CoT,然后是新采样的程序.
在16–20%的转弯线下,在不关闭CoT的情况下,可达到4,096个思考符号的预算,因此不写程序。 DER的剪接没有留下任何结果。
随机目标控制让每个转弯的思维在平面解码的1%范围内,通过率在1.2点之内.
每问题三种子. 如果程序在第一个或第二个转弯后通过所有测试,平均在种子上,而思维符则平均在转弯和种子上,通过通过率算作一个问题得到解决。
